signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: The backoffice is for Kinetix administrators. Every sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app.
challenge.title: Enter the code
challenge.lead: Open your authenticator app and enter the six digits it shows for Kinetix.
code.label: Code
code.description: Six digits. A new one appears every 30 seconds.
enrolment.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enrolment.lead: Administrators sign in with a second factor. Scan the code with an authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
enrolment.qrLabel: QR code for an authenticator app
enrolment.manual: Cannot scan it? Enter this key by hand:
notice.enrolled: Two-factor authentication is on. Sign in again; this time you will be asked for a code.
notice.alreadyEnrolled: This account already has two-factor authentication. Sign in again to use it.
notice.pendingEnded: The sign-in in progress has ended. Start again.
notice.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
notice.roleRefused: This account cannot use the backoffice.
validation.password: Enter the password, at least 6 characters.
refusal.signInRefused: The email or the password is not correct.
refusal.invalidRequest: Check what you entered and try again.
refusal.codeRefused: That code was not accepted. Enter the next code your app shows.
refusal.accountDelayed: Too many unsuccessful attempts on this account. Wait before the next one.
expiry.title: Your session is about to end
expiry.body: Without activity, the session ends in {time}.
signOut.failed: You are still signed in: the sign-out could not reach identity. Try again.
error.title: This page could not be shown
failure.networkRefused: The backoffice answers only from Kinetix's staff network.
failure.rateLimited: Too many requests from this network. Wait before trying again.
failure.unavailable: A service the backoffice needs cannot be reached right now. Nothing was changed.
failure.unreachable: The backoffice cannot be reached. Check the network connection.
failure.unexpected: The backoffice got an answer it does not expect. Reference: {reference}
notFound.title: Nothing is here.
notFound.body: This address does not match any page of the backoffice.
nav.label: Backoffice sections
shell.offline: This device is offline. Figures stay as they were until it is back.
shell.unreachable: The backoffice server does not answer. Retrying on its own; over Tor this can take a minute.
shell.budgetHeld: Every admin shares one request budget, and it ran out. Requests resume in {time}.

overview.paused: Refreshing is paused while you are away, so an idle session can end. Move or press a key to resume.
overview.stale: Not refreshed: the last reading is shown.
